answer.answer:
已查到可引用的部分資料：

### Short answer
To compare our Signaling / Non-signaling Tester solution with a competitor for AI without unsupported claims, we need formal R&S product/specification evidence, formal competitor evidence, and AI-specific evidence such as product version, deployment boundary, supported releases, validation method, benchmarks, and security/data-governance details; current passages show that several available sources are sales positioning or press-release claims, not enough for binding technical comparison.[62][66][94]
### Evidence required
| Area | Required evidence before making a comparison | Why it is required |
|---|---|---|
| R&S Signaling Tester facts | Use formal CMX500 specifications and Features/Functions evidence for CMX500 signaling, application, WLAN, fading, automation interfaces, options, order numbers, release/version, and limits.[13][78][79][80] | CMX500 battle-card pages cannot replace CMX500 formal specifications or features documents.[62] |
| R&S Non-signaling Tester facts | Use formal CMP180 and CMP200 specifications/features evidence for non-signaling / production / FR2 mmWave roles, options, ordering data, calibration conditions, and tolerance limits.[16][18][19][20][21] | CMP200 product data distinguishes guaranteed specifications from typical/nominal/measured data, and data without tolerance limits is not binding.[20][21] |
| AI capability facts | Use formal AI product documentation that states product name, version, order/license code, supported CMX software release, XLAPI/Python/package scope, deployment type, validation workflow, error handling, security, data residency, IP handling, and update governance.[26][94][96] | The CMX500 AI Scripting Assistant source is a press-release-style source and does not provide formal product model, version, license code, order number, supported releases, validation method, security/data-residency/IP-handling details, or concrete deployment types.[26][94][96] |
| AI performance claims | Provide benchmark data, correctness metrics, coverage matrix, supported script package list, and validation conditions before claiming better accuracy, less effort, or faster workflow.[92][94] | The current AI Scripting Assistant page records claims such as generating accurate XLAPI scripts with less time and effort, but it explicitly says no benchmark, correctness metric, coverage matrix, package list, or verification conditions are provided.[92] |
| Competitor facts | Use competitor official documents and preferably third-party evidence for competitor product capabilities, AI tools, toolchain, options, versions, SKUs, deployment, and limitations.[62][66] | Current Keysight and amarisoft competitor claims are based on R&S internal battle cards, and the passages say customer-facing documents should additionally use competitor official data and third-party evidence.[62][66] |
| Claims such as “only,” “first,” “leadership,” “lower TCO,” or “fewer boxes” | Provide formal evidence such as validation reports, test case lists, PTCRB/GCF references, TCO model, configuration bill of materials, integration workflow, or other verifiable documentation before using those claims.[28][62] | The passages explicitly classify “only platform,” “first validated,” “leadership,” “lower TCO,” and “fewer boxes” as sales language rather than verifiable technical specifications.[62] |
| Direct AI comparison | Provide a source that directly compares the R&S AI solution and the competitor AI solution on the same workflow, scope, versions, metrics, and constraints.[3][61][62] | The available Keysight comparison positions R&S unified automation against Keysight tools, but the same page says AI Script Assistant, CONTEST, and Keysight RaySim / Atlas / Channel Studio formal boundaries and versions still need sources.[3][61][62] |
| Governance and customer deployment fit | Provide evidence for data residency, air-gapped support, cloud/LLM approval, allowed models, data handling, and “no code leaves the lab” requirements.[53] | The AI-assisted workflow passages say these governance constraints affect adoption, while the CMX500 AI Scripting Assistant PR does not provide data residency, customer IP handling, deployment boundary, model governance, or security controls.[53] |
### What cannot be claimed yet
A binding technical comparison that R&S is better than a competitor for AI is not supported by the cited passages because the competitor claims are internal battle-card positioning and the AI Scripting Assistant sources lack formal version, deployment, validation, security, and benchmark details.[62][66][94]
A claim that the CMX500 AI Scripting Assistant is commercially available in a specific deployment model such as cloud, on-prem, hybrid, or air-gapped is not supported because the source only says “various deployment options” and does not define them.[96]
A claim that R&S has lower TCO, fewer boxes, or AI leadership versus a competitor should not be made from the current evidence because those terms are identified as sales language requiring formal evidence.[28][62]

R&S CMX500 vs Keysight
本頁整理 [[2026_02_CMX500_Keysight_Sales_Battle_Card]] 中 [[R&S CMX500]] 對 [[Keysight]] 的競品比較論點；其性質是 sales positioning，不是 binding technical specifications。

R&S CMX500 vs Keysight › Sales landmines
[[2026_02_CMX500_Keysight_Sales_Battle_Card]] 建議用以下問題區分需求：

1. 要覆蓋 FR1、FR2、Wi-Fi 7、RedCap 與 NTN 時，需要多少 UXM models，且誰負責 integration？
2. 是否需要 integrated fading、Doppler 與 satellite mobility in one box，或能接受 RaySim / Channel Studio / ProbSim 等 external tools？
3. 是否需要 one unified automation environment，而不是 six separate tools？
4. 是否需要 Wi-Fi 6 / 6E / 7 on every test configuration？
5. 是否需要 validated 3GPP NR-NTN conformance（RF + RRM + PCT）with ecosystem partner，以因應 operator 或 certification pressure？
6. 轉向 FR3 時，是否要 upgrade same platform（例如 add an RF unit），或導入 new boxes and new software？
7. RedCap testing 是否要在 main 5G signaling tester 中，或能接受 separate RedCap-only box？
8. Operators 或 certification bodies 是否要求 specific timeline 上的 validated NR-NTN conformance？
9. 團隊需要學習與維護多少不同 software environments，且 tool updates 是否會破壞 automation？

R&S CMX500 vs Keysight › 對比表
| 主題 | R&S / CMX500 positioning | Keysight positioning | 來源限制 |
|---|---|---|---|
| Platform architecture | one platform：FR1 + FR2 + FR3 + WLAN + fading + IP + NTN + LTE + RedCap | multiple UXM SKUs：[[Keysight E7515P]]、[[Keysight E7515W]]、[[Keysight E7515B]] / [[Keysight E7515E]]、[[Keysight E7515R]] + external tools | battle card 未提供 Keysight 官方資料；R&S one-platform 說法需回查 CMX500 options |
| FR1 / FR2 | quick table 寫 FR1 up to 18 GHz、FR2 up to 50 GHz (RRH evo) | E7515P up to 15 GHz；FR2 split 24.25–29.5 GHz and 37–43.5 GHz | R&S FR1 up to 18 GHz 與正式規格口徑衝突，見 [[FR3 測試與 RFU18 battle card 主張]] |
| RFU18 / FR3 | [[RFU18]] up to 18 GHz；max aggregated NR bandwidth 2000 MHz；single-platform FR3 path | UXM-P bandwidth options + RaySim + future hardware / software；multi-component approach | RFU18 未有正式規格文件；Keysight roadmap 需官方證據 |
| Wi-Fi | Wi-Fi 6 / 6E / 7 signaling possible to integrate in every CMX500 configuration | Wi-Fi only on selected models：E7515W、E7515P | CMX500 WLAN options 需回查 [[CMX500_Features_CSW9-20-0_en_32]]；Keysight 需官方資料 |
| Fading / Doppler / satellite | integrated in one box | [[RaySim]] / [[Channel Studio]] / [[ProbSim]] external for advanced fading and digital twin | source 未列 option code 或正式 workflow |
| IP / application testing | Integrated FTP / HTTP / DNS、IMS、VoNR、VoWiFi | often additional tools and PC | CMX500 application options 需回查正式 features 文件 |
| Software / automation | [[CMsquares]]、[[R&S CMsequencer]]、[[CONTEST]]、[[AI Script Assistant]] as one ecosystem | [[Atlas]] + [[Channel Studio]] + [[RaySim]] + WLAN tools + [[Nemo]] + UXM features | AI Script Assistant / CONTEST 在本來源中未提供文件版次；Keysight toolchain 需官方資料 |

R&S CMX500 vs amarisoft
本頁整理 [[2026_02_CMX500_Amarisoft_Sales_Battle_Card]] 中的競品比較論點；其性質是 sales positioning，不是 binding technical specifications。

R&S CMX500 vs amarisoft › Sales landmines
[[2026_02_CMX500_Amarisoft_Sales_Battle_Card]] 建議用以下問題區分需求：

1. 是否需要 calibrated [[FR2]] / [[mmWave]] testing？
2. 是否需要 global support、multi-year warranty 或 calibration services？
3. 是否需要 [[Operator Acceptance]]、[[Conformance Testing]] 或 pre-conformance？
4. 是否需要 validated / [[PTCRB]] / [[GCF]] aligned test cases，而不只是 functional simulation？
5. 是否需要 non-signaling ATE 或 multi-port production test？
6. 是否需要 integrated [[Wi-Fi signaling]]（6/6E/7）？
7. 是否需要 factory line 的 non-signaling test capability？
8. 是否需要 3GPP RF pre-conformance 或 aligned test coverage？

R&S CMX500 vs amarisoft › R&S offensive plays
依 [[2026_02_CMX500_Amarisoft_Sales_Battle_Card]]：

- **One-Box FR1 + FR2 + Wi-Fi Signaling + Validated Testing**：將 [[R&S CMX500]] 定位為 integrated platform。
- **Migration Kit**：script conversion、Python / [[XLAPI]] mapping、on-site bring-up、trade-in program；來源未列交付細節或商務條件。
- **NTN & RedCap Acceleration**：強化 validated vs. simulated message。
- **O-RAN Upgrade Path**：R&S + [[VIAVI]] → ORU conformance / NES；來源未展開產品與規格。
- **Production Path (ATE)**：將 CMX validation scale 到 [[R&S CMP180]]、[[R&S CMP200]]、[[R&S CMW100 K06]] production lines。

AISeverEcosystem R&S solution mapping
[[AISeverEcosystem R&S solution mapping]] 是用來保存 [[AISeverEcosystem]] 中 AI server ecosystem 分類與 [[R&S Solution]] 欄位對應關係的概念頁；它只表示該 Excel 表中的銷售 / 測試方案線索，不代表正式產品配置、客戶關係或已驗證商機。

AISeverEcosystem R&S solution mapping › Optical / SiPh / CPO
- [[矽光子]]欄將 optical VNA 對應到 [[R&S ZNA]] / [[R&S ZNB]] + PSA with [[ThinkLands]]，以及 [[R&S ZNA]] / [[R&S ZNB]] + [[GOCA]] with [[Newkey]]。
- 來源角色亮點稱 [[CPO]] 對有源 / 無源 [[SiPh]]、先進封裝與測試需求大幅提升，並稱 [[前鼎]]提供高速載板給矽光子模組與 CPO 元件、[[光聖]]提供 ELS 外部雷射源。
- 這些說法都只追溯到 [[AISeverEcosystem]]，不等同於量產、採購、出貨或 R&S formal application note。

AISeverEcosystem R&S solution mapping › 與既有知識的關係
- [[R&S PCB test solutions]] 提供 2026.3.4 R&S high-speed digital 簡報中的 PCB fabricator / system house 測試流程；本頁則來自市場 Excel，將 R&S 儀器與 AI server supply-chain 類別做銷售 mapping。
- [[高頻高速 PCB 測試解決方案]] 與 [[Dk-Df]]、[[Delta-L]]、[[TDR 阻抗測量]] 已有 Keysight / PCB test 圖像來源；本頁新增 R&S 方案對應，但未提供可替代正式規格的量測條件。
- [[AI 伺服器 PCB 供應鏈升級]] 記錄材料與板層升級；本頁只補充對應測試入口，例如 IL、TDR、high speed trace、PDN Target Z。
- [[資料中心電力電子生態系]]、[[NVIDIA 800V HVDC 架構]] 與 [[AI 資料中心高壓直流供電]] 記錄 data center power electronics；本頁補充 [[MXO]]、[[R&S FSWP]]、[[ZISO]] 與 BMS test 的 sales mapping 線索。

- 來源同時列出部分公司、台股代號、角色亮點、[[R&S Solution]] 與 sales kits 連結；多數欄位為 `NaN`，因此不可推論未填欄位代表不適用、無需求或無 R&S solution。
- [[ServerRack]] sheet 中，[[伺服器主機板]] / PCBA 的 [[R&S Solution]] 欄列出 [[R&S ZNL]] 用於 PDN Target Z、[[MXO]] 用於 power rail / multiphase DC / PI、[[ZISO]]、[[R&S FSWP]] 用於 LDO NSD test / clock jitter test、[[R&S ZNA]] 用於 high speed trace test。

- [[資料中心電力電子生態系]] 與 [[NVIDIA 800V HVDC 架構]] 已整理 HVDC、PSU、BBU、PDU 等 power electronics 脈絡；本來源補充電源供應器分類中的 HVDC、5–10 kW PSU、液冷電源櫃、BBU 與 Blackwell 平台功耗翻倍說法，但未提供引用文件或期間。
- [[R&S PCB test solutions]] 已整理 R&S 2026.3.4 high-speed digital 簡報中的 material measurement、stackup selection、SI testing 與 sampling / process monitoring；本來源把部分 R&S solution 對應到特定市場分類，例如 [[R&S ZNA]] / [[R&S ZNB]] 的 IL / TDR、[[R&S FSWP]] 的 jitter / phase noise / LDO NSD test、[[MXO]] 的 power rail / motor driver analysis。

R&S CMX500 › 產品定位
依 [[CMX500_specs_en_5216-4127-22_v1100]]，[[R&S CMX500]] 是 universal one-box network emulation and measurement test solution，支援最新 3GPP [[5G NR]] technology，適用於 device testing，涵蓋 [[LTE]]、[[NR FR1]]、[[NR FR2]]，並支援 non-standalone（NSA）、standalone（SA）、FDD 與 TDD。

依 [[CMX500_Features_CSW9-20-0_en_32]]，[[R&S CMX500]] 也提供：

- [[NR FR1]] / [[NR FR2]] signaling 與 TX measurements。
- [[LTE]] signaling、LTE-DTC / direct-to-cell communication、LTE measurements。
- [[NB-IoT]] / NB-NTN signaling。
- [[WLAN]] signaling 與 WLAN TX measurements，涵蓋 802.11a/b/g/n/ac、802.11ax、802.11be、802.11bn 與 2x2 MIMO。
- [[Fading]]、[[AWGN]]、[[BLER]]、[[CSI report]]、[[Throughput measurement]]、[[PER measurement]]。
- Application test、IP traffic analysis、IMS / audio / [[POLQA]]。
- GUI、graphical scripting、Python-based [[XLAPI]] 與 [[SCPI]] remote control。

R&S CMX500
[[R&S CMX500]] 是 [[Rohde & Schwarz]] 的 Radio Communication Tester；依 [[CMX500_specs_en_5216-4127-22_v1100]] Specifications Version 11.00（August 2025），它是 universal one-box network emulation and measurement test solution，支援 [[LTE]]、[[NR FR1]]、[[NR FR2]]、NSA、SA、FDD、TDD、FR1/FR2 RF parametric testing、fading propagation conditions 與多種 OBT hardware configurations。

R&S CMX500 › mmWave extension 與 remote radio heads
[[CMX500_specs_en_5216-4127-22_v1100]] 指出 3GPP FR2 frequency range 測試可由 [[R&S CMX500]] 搭配 [[R&S CMXHEAD30]]、[[R&S CMXHEAD50]] 或 [[R&S CMXHEAD50-Evo]] 執行。Remote radio head 是獨立 compact unit，在 IF 與 5G NR FR2 frequency ranges 間執行 upconversion / downconversion。CMX500 與 remote radio head 的 split concept 可在 5G NR FR2 frequency range 使用短 RF cable lengths，以最佳化 radiated chamber test environments 的 link budget。

適用 radiated chamber test environments：[[R&S CMQ500]] shielding cube 與 [[R&S ATS800R]] CATR rack based antenna test system。

R&S CMP180 › 產品定位
[[R&S CMP180]] 是 Radio Communication Tester。依 [[CMP180 Features and Functions Version 09]]，文件涵蓋 global options、Bluetooth、CDMA2000、GSM、LP-IoT、LTE、NB-IoT、NR、spectrum analysis、UWB、WCDMA、WLAN、[[R&S VSE]] options 與 ordering information。

依 [[CMP180 Specifications Version 08.00]]，CMP180 支援 simultaneous receiver and transmitter testing，並提供 RF generator/analyzer no. 1 與可選 RF generator/analyzer no. 2 的多埠 RF 測試架構。

R&S CMP180
[[R&S CMP180]] 是 [[Rohde & Schwarz]] 的 **Radio Communication Tester**，用於 production / wireless communication device 測試，依文件可配置多埠 RF generator/analyzer、通訊標準 measurement options、waveform options 與 [[R&S VSE]] 分析能力。

R&S CMP180 › 文件依據與版本
本頁目前依兩份 Productions 來源整理：

- [[CMP180 Features and Functions Version 09]]：文件識別碼 **1179.5118.02**，**Version 09**，對應 software **V11.9 or higher**，版權標示 © 2026；此文件是 test applications overview，並明示量測範圍與 tolerance limits 需參考 specifications document **PD 3609.7348.22**。
- [[CMP180 Specifications Version 08.00]]：文件識別碼 **PD 3609.7348.22**，**Version 08.00**，日期 **March 2026**；此文件提供 specifications、general data、ordering information、warranty 與 service。

R&S CMP200 › 產品定位
依 [[CMP200_specs_en_5216-4391-22_v0800]]，[[R&S CMP200]] 與 [[R&S CMPHEAD30]] / [[R&S CMPHEAD50]] remote radio head（RRH）形成 5G NR FR2（mmWave）nonsignaling one-box test solution，目標應用為：

- R&D 的 RF parametric testing。
- Manufacturing 的 high-volume RF parametric testing。
- Fully assembled smart devices 的 pure radiated mmWave setup。
- 具 IF interface 的 mmWave RF integrated circuits 的 mixed radiated mmWave / conducted IF setup。
- 具 mmWave interface 的 mmWave RF integrated circuits 的 mixed radiated mmWave / conducted mmWave setup。

CMP200 本體提供 IF frequency range 的 vector signal analysis 與 ARB-based generator functionality；[[R&S CMPHEAD30]] / [[R&S CMPHEAD50]] 作為 compact remote radio head，負責 upconversion / downconversion 至 5G NR FR2 frequencies。分離式 one-box tester + RRH 架構可在 mmWave frequency range 使用較短 RF cable lengths，以改善 radiated test environments 的 link budget。

R&S CMP200 › Specifications data sheet
本頁硬體、IF、RRH、UWB head、ordering、mechanical、environmental 與 conformance 相關主張主要來自 [[CMP200_specs_en_5216-4391-22_v0800]]：

- 文件名稱：**CMP200 Radio Communication Tester Specifications Data Sheet**。
- 文件代碼：**PD 5216.4391.22**。
- 文件版本：**Version 08.00**。
- 文件日期：**August 2024**。
- 版權：**© 2019–2024 Rohde & Schwarz**。
- 產品：**Rohde & Schwarz CMP200 Radio Communication Tester**。
- 注意：**Data without tolerance limits is not binding**；**Subject to change**。
- Recommended calibration interval：CMP200 與 RRH 為 **12 months**；[[R&S CM-Z310A]] UWB head 為 **24 months**。

R&S CMP200 › Product data 使用限制
依 [[CMP200_specs_en_5216-4391-22_v0800]]：

- Product data 適用條件為 ambient temperature 儲存 3 小時後 warm-up operation 30 分鐘、符合指定 environmental conditions、遵守 recommended calibration interval，且如適用需完成 all internal automatic adjustments。
- Specifications with limits 代表保證的 product performance，以 `<`、`≤`、`>`、`≥`、`±`、maximum、limit of、minimum 等形式標示。
- Non-traceable specifications with limits（n. trc.）依 limits 測試，但因 measuring equipment 不可追溯至 national metrology standards，Rohde & Schwarz 不保證其 performance。
- Typical data（typ.）、nominal values（nom.）、measured values（meas.）均不由 Rohde & Schwarz 保證。
- Uncertainties 採 coverage factor 2，依 GUM 計算。
- 3GPP 標準中 chip rates 以 Mcps 表示，bit rates / symbol rates 以 Gbps、Mbps、kbps、Msps、ksps 表示，sample rates 以 Msample/s 表示；這些不是 SI units。

CMX500 AI Scripting Assistant
[[CMX500 AI Scripting Assistant]] 是 [[Rohde & Schwarz]] 新聞稿中介紹的 [[R&S CMX500]] 5G one-box signaling tester AI-powered scripting tool，使用 generative AI 與 natural language processing 協助測試工程師生成、擴充與理解 [[XLAPI]] scripts。

CMX500 AI Scripting Assistant › 產品定位
依 [[CMX500 AI Scripting Assistant from Rohde & Schwarz facilitates mobile device testing through AI-driven automation]]，[[CMX500 AI Scripting Assistant]] 是為 [[R&S CMX500]] 開發的 AI-driven scripting support solution。來源將它定位為可 automate test script generation and functional testing 的工具，目標是協助 mobile device manufacturers 的 test engineers：

- streamline workflows；
- reduce the risk of errors；
- speed up time-to-market；
- 以 tailored and efficient approach automating domain-specific applications。

來源中的 domain-specific applications 包含：

- R&D [[5G NR]] protocol testing；
- application testing；
- CMX instrument automation；
- many more（來源未展開）。

CMX500 AI Scripting Assistant › Script generation inputs
來源描述測試工程師手動產生 test scripts 時，常需從多個來源彙整輸入。來源明示的來源類型包括：

- [[3GPP specifications]]；
- [[XLAPI]] scripts；
- [[Python]]；
- [[R&S CMX500]] user manual。

[[CMX500 AI Scripting Assistant]] 被描述為用來緩解這種 multi-source script generation challenge 的新 solution。

CMX500 AI Scripting Assistant from Rohde & Schwarz facilitates mobile device testing through AI-driven automation › 重點摘要
- [[Rohde & Schwarz]] 宣稱已開發 [[CMX500 AI Scripting Assistant]]，用於 automate test script generation and functional testing，對象是 [[R&S CMX500]] 5G one-box signaling tester。
- 工具使用 generative AI 與 natural language processing，目標是 streamlining workflows、reducing the risk of errors，以及 speeding up time-to-market。
- 來源描述的使用者痛點是：mobile device manufacturers 的 test engineers 需在時間壓力下，從多個來源手動彙整測試腳本輸入；來源列出的輸入包括 [[3GPP specifications]]、[[XLAPI]] scripts、[[Python]] 與 [[R&S CMX500]] user manual。
- [[CMX500 AI Scripting Assistant]] 的 domain-specific applications 包含 R&D [[5G NR]] protocol testing、application testing、CMX instrument automation and many more。
- 來源宣稱工具可生成 accurate [[XLAPI]] scripts with significantly less time and effort，也可以 extend existing scripts 並 provide explanations for given scripts，以協助較少經驗的使用者理解 scripts 的 structure and logic。
- 來源宣稱工具具有 exclusive access to proprietary data from [[Rohde & Schwarz]]，並存取 derived from expertise of Rohde & Schwarz 的 specialized resources；來源也說明工具以 relevant data 訓練並自動整合 updates，以維持 current and accurate。
- 來源說 [[CMX500 AI Scripting Assistant]] 可透過 various deployment options 取得，但未列出部署類型、版本、license code、order number 或硬體需求。
- 來源說 MWC 2025 Barcelona 的訪客可在 Rohde & Schwarz booth hall 5, booth 5A80 現場體驗該工具。

2026_02_CMX500_Keysight_Sales_Battle_Card › Keysight 相關
- [[Keysight]] — 本 battle card 的競品公司。
- [[Keysight UXM]] — 來源中的 UXM 5G Wireless Test Platforms 總稱。
- [[Keysight E7515P]] — 來源稱 high-end wideband / 5G platform with Wi-Fi as additional capability；quick table 稱 E7515P up to 15 GHz。
- [[Keysight E7515W]] — 來源稱 Wi-Fi 7 / connectivity platform。
- [[Keysight E7515B]] — 來源稱 standard / mid-tier 5G UXM。
- [[Keysight E7515E]] — 來源稱 value / mid-tier 5G UXM。
- [[Keysight E7515R]] — 來源稱 RedCap / IoT-only SKU。
- [[ProbSim]] — channel emulator；來源在 integrated vs external fading landmine 中列名。
- [[RaySim]] — digital twin / ray tracing engine；來源說 advanced fading、digital twin、FR3 / 6G scenarios 可能需要 RaySim。
- [[Channel Studio]] — channel modeling / fading 相關 external tool。
- [[Nemo]] — field test tools；來源列於 Keysight fragmented toolchain。
- [[Atlas]] — AI-powered device test / test management；來源列於 Keysight fragmented toolchain。
- [[KeysightCare]] — 來源說 Keysight support model 使用 tiered KeysightCare：Assured、Enhanced、Application Software Support，以及 optional warranty / calibration assurance plan。

2026_02_CMX500_Keysight_Sales_Battle_Card › 重點摘要
- 來源將 [[Keysight]] 描述為大型美國 test & measurement vendor，總部在 Santa Rosa, California, USA，員工數約 **16,800+**，在 semiconductor、aerospace / defense、cloud 與 wireless testing 具有強市場存在。
- 來源主張 [[Keysight]] mobile communications strategy 越來越 software-led 與 AI-driven，但 [[Keysight UXM]] portfolio 分散於多個 hardware SKUs：[[Keysight E7515P]]、[[Keysight E7515W]]、[[Keysight E7515B]]、[[Keysight E7515E]]、[[Keysight E7515R]]。
- 來源列出 [[Keysight]] portfolio 包含 UXM 5G Wireless Test Platforms、[[ProbSim]] channel emulators、[[Nemo]] field test tools、[[RaySim]] digital twin engine、[[Atlas]] AI-powered device test、C-V2X 與 cybersecurity tools。
- 來源把 R&S positioning 表述為：[[R&S CMX500]] 在 one instrument 中整合 [[NR FR1]]、[[NR FR2]]、[[Wi-Fi]]、[[Fading]]、IP throughput、RF analysis、[[NTN]]、[[RedCap]] 與 end-to-end signaling；而 Keysight 需分散於多個 UXM models、add-on software 與 external tools。
- 來源主張 [[R&S CMX500]] 的差異化包含 one-platform architecture、integrated fading + IP + application testing、unified software ecosystem（[[CMsquares]]、[[R&S CMsequencer]]、AI Script Assistant）、measurement leadership、FR3 / 6G path、cellular + Wi-Fi in one platform，以及 NTN / RedCap / operator certification leadership。
- 來源對 [[Keysight]] 的弱點敘述包含 hardware fragmentation、multi-tool workflow、advanced testing external dependencies、limited legacy、Wi-Fi only on selected models、FR3 / 6G roadmap relies on add-ons。
- 來源的 quick comparison table 將 R&S / CMX500 描述為 one platform：FR1 + FR2 + FR3 + WLAN + fading + IP + NTN + LTE + RedCap；將 Keysight 描述為 multiple UXM SKUs + external tools。

2026_02_CMX500_Amarisoft_Sales_Battle_Card › 實體
- [[R&S CMX500]] — 來源主角；被定位為 integrated platform for signaling、validated testing、FR1、FR2 up to 50 GHz 與 Wi-Fi signaling。
- [[amarisoft]] — 競品；來源稱其為 small French private company，提供 software-based 4G/5G network stacks and test systems。
- [[AMARI Callbox Series]] — [[amarisoft]] product line，包含 Mini、Classic、Advanced、Ultimate、Extreme。
- [[UE Simbox Series]] — [[amarisoft]] product line。
- [[R&S CMW500]] — 來源稱其提供 2G/3G legacy continuity，並屬於 R&S full test lifecycle 中的 legacy platform。
- [[R&S CMP180]]、[[R&S CMP200]]、[[R&S CMW100 K06]] — 來源稱其構成 R&S production / ATE scaling path。
- [[Samsung]] — 來源稱 R&S validated NR-NTN RF / RRM / protocol testcases “w/ Samsung”；未提供專案、文件或測試案例編號。
- [[VIAVI]] — 來源稱 R&S + VIAVI 可提供 O-RAN upgrade path，對比 [[amarisoft]] functional DU/RU testing；未提供產品、文件或合作細節。

2026_02_CMX500_Amarisoft_Sales_Battle_Card › 概念
- [[Sales Battle Card]] — 本來源的文件類型；用於競品比較與銷售定位，不是正式 specifications。
- [[Validated Testing]] — 來源用來區分 R&S validated / PTCRB-GCF aligned test cases 與 [[amarisoft]] functional simulation。
- [[Conformance Testing]]、[[Operator Acceptance]]、[[PTCRB]]、[[GCF]] — 來源稱 R&S 支援 aligned RF、RRM、protocol、IMS、VoNR、throughput、CA、mobility tests，而 [[amarisoft]] 不被接受作 operator certification。
- [[NR-NTN]]、[[NTN]]、[[RedCap]] — 來源將其列為 R&S offensive play 與 [[amarisoft]] functional testing 能力對比項目。
- [[Wi-Fi signaling]] — 來源稱 [[R&S CMX500]] 整合 Wi-Fi signaling，含 Wi-Fi 6/6E/7；並稱 [[amarisoft]] 需 external AP/N3IWF 或無 Wi-Fi signaling。
- [[FR2]]、[[mmWave]]、[[Calibrated RF]] — 來源稱 R&S 提供 calibrated FR2 / mmWave，而 [[amarisoft]] 使用 external RRH 且 calibration 以問號標示。
- [[ATE production scalability]]、[[Non-signaling test]] — 來源稱 R&S 可由 CMX validation scale 到 CMP180 / CMP200 / CMW100 production lines。
- [[O-RAN]]、[[ORU conformance]]、[[NES]] — 來源提出 R&S + VIAVI upgrade path，但未展開文件依據。

2026_02_CMX500_Amarisoft_Sales_Battle_Card › 與既有知識的關係
- 既有 [[R&S CMX500]] 頁已依 [[CMX500_specs_en_5216-4127-22_v1100]] 與 [[CMX500_Features_CSW9-20-0_en_32]] 整理正式規格與 Features and Functions。本來源不是 specifications；它補充的是 sales positioning 與競品比較語境。
- 來源稱 [[R&S CMX500]] covers FR2 up to 50 GHz；既有 [[CMX500_specs_en_5216-4127-22_v1100]] 對 [[R&S CMXHEAD50]] / [[R&S CMXHEAD50-Evo]] 列出的 frequency range 是 **21.84 GHz to 50.20 GHz**。判斷本來源的 50 GHz 是 sales battle card 的四捨五入說法，不列為矛盾。
- 來源稱 [[R&S CMX500]] 整合 Wi-Fi signaling（Wi-Fi 6/6E/7）；既有 [[CMX500_Features_CSW9-20-0_en_32]] 已列 WLAN signaling / measurements：802.11ax、802.11be、2.4/4/5/6 GHz bands 等，方向一致。
- 來源把 [[R&S CMW500]] 用於 2G/3G continuity；既有 [[CMW_dat-sw_en_5213-9211-22_v1700]] 已列 GSM、WCDMA、LTE、NR Sub-6GHz、Bluetooth、WLAN 等 CMW wireless standards，方向一致。
- 來源把 [[R&S CMP180]]、[[R&S CMP200]]、[[R&S CMW100 K06]] 作為 production / non-signaling / ATE path；既有各產品頁也把 CMP180、CMP200、CMW100 K06 描述為 production / manufacturing / nonsignaling 測試相關平台，方向一致。
- 來源對 [[amarisoft]] 的資訊是 sales battle card 觀點，且未引用 amarisoft 官方文件；應避免把 “Only R&S” 等銷售語句當作獨立技術規格或市場事實。

2026_02_CMX500_Anritsu_Sales_Battle_Card › 實體
- [[R&S CMX500]] — 來源主角；被定位為 integrated platform for FR1、FR2、FR3、Wi-Fi、fading、IP throughput、NTN、RF analysis 與 signaling。
- [[Anritsu]] — 競品公司；來源描述為 Japanese test & measurement vendor。
- [[Anritsu MT8000A]] — 來源描述為 Anritsu 5G NR FR1/FR2/FR3 測試平台，但需要多 RF boards、multiple boxes、external PC / tools。
- [[Anritsu MD8475B]] — 來源描述為 LTE / IMS / eCall solution。
- [[Anritsu MT8821C]] — 來源描述為 LTE / LTE-A / 3G / 2G RF solution，且 source 說 LTE RF still needs MT8821C。

### Short answer
To compare our Signaling / Non-signaling Tester solution with a competitor for AI without unsupported claims, we need formal R&S product/specification evidence, formal competitor evidence, and AI-specific evidence such as product version, deployment boundary, supported releases, validation method, benchmarks, and security/data-governance details; current passages show that several available sources are sales positioning or press-release claims, not enough for binding technical comparison.[62][66][94]
### Evidence required
| Area | Required evidence before making a comparison | Why it is required |
|---|---|---|
| R&S Signaling Tester facts | Use formal CMX500 specifications and Features/Functions evidence for CMX500 signaling, application, WLAN, fading, automation interfaces, options, order numbers, release/version, and limits.[13][78][79][80] | CMX500 battle-card pages cannot replace CMX500 formal specifications or features documents.[62] |
| R&S Non-signaling Tester facts | Use formal CMP180 and CMP200 specifications/features evidence for non-signaling / production / FR2 mmWave roles, options, ordering data, calibration conditions, and tolerance limits.[16][18][19][20][21] | CMP200 product data distinguishes guaranteed specifications from typical/nominal/measured data, and data without tolerance limits is not binding.[20][21] |
| AI capability facts | Use formal AI product documentation that states product name, version, order/license code, supported CMX software release, XLAPI/Python/package scope, deployment type, validation workflow, error handling, security, data residency, IP handling, and update governance.[26][94][96] | The CMX500 AI Scripting Assistant source is a press-release-style source and does not provide formal product model, version, license code, order number, supported releases, validation method, security/data-residency/IP-handling details, or concrete deployment types.[26][94][96] |
| AI performance claims | Provide benchmark data, correctness metrics, coverage matrix, supported script package list, and validation conditions before claiming better accuracy, less effort, or faster workflow.[92][94] | The current AI Scripting Assistant page records claims such as generating accurate XLAPI scripts with less time and effort, but it explicitly says no benchmark, correctness metric, coverage matrix, package list, or verification conditions are provided.[92] |
| Competitor facts | Use competitor official documents and preferably third-party evidence for competitor product capabilities, AI tools, toolchain, options, versions, SKUs, deployment, and limitations.[62][66] | Current Keysight and amarisoft competitor claims are based on R&S internal battle cards, and the passages say customer-facing documents should additionally use competitor official data and third-party evidence.[62][66] |
| Claims such as “only,” “first,” “leadership,” “lower TCO,” or “fewer boxes” | Provide formal evidence such as validation reports, test case lists, PTCRB/GCF references, TCO model, configuration bill of materials, integration workflow, or other verifiable documentation before using those claims.[28][62] | The passages explicitly classify “only platform,” “first validated,” “leadership,” “lower TCO,” and “fewer boxes” as sales language rather than verifiable technical specifications.[62] |
| Direct AI comparison | Provide a source that directly compares the R&S AI solution and the competitor AI solution on the same workflow, scope, versions, metrics, and constraints.[3][61][62] | The available Keysight comparison positions R&S unified automation against Keysight tools, but the same page says AI Script Assistant, CONTEST, and Keysight RaySim / Atlas / Channel Studio formal boundaries and versions still need sources.[3][61][62] |
| Governance and customer deployment fit | Provide evidence for data residency, air-gapped support, cloud/LLM approval, allowed models, data handling, and “no code leaves the lab” requirements.[53] | The AI-assisted workflow passages say these governance constraints affect adoption, while the CMX500 AI Scripting Assistant PR does not provide data residency, customer IP handling, deployment boundary, model governance, or security controls.[53] |
### What cannot be claimed yet
A binding technical comparison that R&S is better than a competitor for AI is not supported by the cited passages because the competitor claims are internal battle-card positioning and the AI Scripting Assistant sources lack formal version, deployment, validation, security, and benchmark details.[62][66][94]
A claim that the CMX500 AI Scripting Assistant is commercially available in a specific deployment model such as cloud, on-prem, hybrid, or air-gapped is not supported because the source only says “various deployment options” and does not define them.[96]
A claim that R&S has lower TCO, fewer boxes, or AI leadership versus a competitor should not be made from the current evidence because those terms are identified as sales language requiring formal evidence.[28][62]

R&S CMX500 vs Keysight
本頁整理 [[2026_02_CMX500_Keysight_Sales_Battle_Card]] 中 [[R&S CMX500]] 對 [[Keysight]] 的競品比較論點；其性質是 sales positioning，不是 binding technical specifications。

R&S CMX500 vs Keysight › Sales landmines
[[2026_02_CMX500_Keysight_Sales_Battle_Card]] 建議用以下問題區分需求：

1. 要覆蓋 FR1、FR2、Wi-Fi 7、RedCap 與 NTN 時，需要多少 UXM models，且誰負責 integration？
2. 是否需要 integrated fading、Doppler 與 satellite mobility in one box，或能接受 RaySim / Channel Studio / ProbSim 等 external tools？
3. 是否需要 one unified automation environment，而不是 six separate tools？
4. 是否需要 Wi-Fi 6 / 6E / 7 on every test configuration？
5. 是否需要 validated 3GPP NR-NTN conformance（RF + RRM + PCT）with ecosystem partner，以因應 operator 或 certification pressure？
6. 轉向 FR3 時，是否要 upgrade same platform（例如 add an RF unit），或導入 new boxes and new software？
7. RedCap testing 是否要在 main 5G signaling tester 中，或能接受 separate RedCap-only box？
8. Operators 或 certification bodies 是否要求 specific timeline 上的 validated NR-NTN conformance？
9. 團隊需要學習與維護多少不同 software environments，且 tool updates 是否會破壞 automation？

R&S CMX500 vs Keysight › 對比表
| 主題 | R&S / CMX500 positioning | Keysight positioning | 來源限制 |
|---|---|---|---|
| Platform architecture | one platform：FR1 + FR2 + FR3 + WLAN + fading + IP + NTN + LTE + RedCap | multiple UXM SKUs：[[Keysight E7515P]]、[[Keysight E7515W]]、[[Keysight E7515B]] / [[Keysight E7515E]]、[[Keysight E7515R]] + external tools | battle card 未提供 Keysight 官方資料；R&S one-platform 說法需回查 CMX500 options |
| FR1 / FR2 | quick table 寫 FR1 up to 18 GHz、FR2 up to 50 GHz (RRH evo) | E7515P up to 15 GHz；FR2 split 24.25–29.5 GHz and 37–43.5 GHz | R&S FR1 up to 18 GHz 與正式規格口徑衝突，見 [[FR3 測試與 RFU18 battle card 主張]] |
| RFU18 / FR3 | [[RFU18]] up to 18 GHz；max aggregated NR bandwidth 2000 MHz；single-platform FR3 path | UXM-P bandwidth options + RaySim + future hardware / software；multi-component approach | RFU18 未有正式規格文件；Keysight roadmap 需官方證據 |
| Wi-Fi | Wi-Fi 6 / 6E / 7 signaling possible to integrate in every CMX500 configuration | Wi-Fi only on selected models：E7515W、E7515P | CMX500 WLAN options 需回查 [[CMX500_Features_CSW9-20-0_en_32]]；Keysight 需官方資料 |
| Fading / Doppler / satellite | integrated in one box | [[RaySim]] / [[Channel Studio]] / [[ProbSim]] external for advanced fading and digital twin | source 未列 option code 或正式 workflow |
| IP / application testing | Integrated FTP / HTTP / DNS、IMS、VoNR、VoWiFi | often additional tools and PC | CMX500 application options 需回查正式 features 文件 |
| Software / automation | [[CMsquares]]、[[R&S CMsequencer]]、[[CONTEST]]、[[AI Script Assistant]] as one ecosystem | [[Atlas]] + [[Channel Studio]] + [[RaySim]] + WLAN tools + [[Nemo]] + UXM features | AI Script Assistant / CONTEST 在本來源中未提供文件版次；Keysight toolchain 需官方資料 |

R&S CMX500 vs amarisoft
本頁整理 [[2026_02_CMX500_Amarisoft_Sales_Battle_Card]] 中的競品比較論點；其性質是 sales positioning，不是 binding technical specifications。

R&S CMX500 vs amarisoft › Sales landmines
[[2026_02_CMX500_Amarisoft_Sales_Battle_Card]] 建議用以下問題區分需求：

1. 是否需要 calibrated [[FR2]] / [[mmWave]] testing？
2. 是否需要 global support、multi-year warranty 或 calibration services？
3. 是否需要 [[Operator Acceptance]]、[[Conformance Testing]] 或 pre-conformance？
4. 是否需要 validated / [[PTCRB]] / [[GCF]] aligned test cases，而不只是 functional simulation？
5. 是否需要 non-signaling ATE 或 multi-port production test？
6. 是否需要 integrated [[Wi-Fi signaling]]（6/6E/7）？
7. 是否需要 factory line 的 non-signaling test capability？
8. 是否需要 3GPP RF pre-conformance 或 aligned test coverage？

R&S CMX500 vs amarisoft › R&S offensive plays
依 [[2026_02_CMX500_Amarisoft_Sales_Battle_Card]]：

- **One-Box FR1 + FR2 + Wi-Fi Signaling + Validated Testing**：將 [[R&S CMX500]] 定位為 integrated platform。
- **Migration Kit**：script conversion、Python / [[XLAPI]] mapping、on-site bring-up、trade-in program；來源未列交付細節或商務條件。
- **NTN & RedCap Acceleration**：強化 validated vs. simulated message。
- **O-RAN Upgrade Path**：R&S + [[VIAVI]] → ORU conformance / NES；來源未展開產品與規格。
- **Production Path (ATE)**：將 CMX validation scale 到 [[R&S CMP180]]、[[R&S CMP200]]、[[R&S CMW100 K06]] production lines。

- [[AI Server 供應鏈總覽]] 已整理 AI server 從 demand、compute、ODM、networking、PCB/interconnect、power、cooling 到 infrastructure 的八段式供應鏈；本來源新增更偏台股 / customer targeting / R&S solution mapping 的 Excel 表格視角。

- [[AI 伺服器 ODM]] 已整理台系 ODM 比較表與組裝代工列名；本來源在 [[伺服器整合／ODM]] 欄再次列出 [[鴻海]]、[[廣達]]、[[緯創]]、[[緯穎]]、[[英業達]]、[[華碩]]、[[神達]]、[[技嘉]]，但沒有營收、出貨或期間資料。
- [[AI 伺服器 PCB 供應鏈升級]] 已記錄 GB200 / GB300 / VR200 與 PCB 材料升級；本來源只以 `GB200/NVL72帶動層數、材料等級暴衝` 和 `20+層UBB、高階ABF、低Dk CCL` 補充銷售 / solution mapping 脈絡，沒有新增可量化規格。
- [[AI 伺服器液冷散熱]] 已整理液冷 / Microchannel lid 與 VR200 散熱估算；本來源新增 [[GPU]] TDP 700 W → 1200 W 與液冷 / 滑軌升級的表格說法，但未標示平台、年份或測試條件。
- [[資料中心電力電子生態系]] 與 [[NVIDIA 800V HVDC 架構]] 已整理 HVDC、PSU、BBU、PDU 等 power electronics 脈絡；本來源補充電源供應器分類中的 HVDC、5–10 kW PSU、液冷電源櫃、BBU 與 Blackwell 平台功耗翻倍說法，但未提供引用文件或期間。
- [[R&S PCB test solutions]] 已整理 R&S 2026.3.4 high-speed digital 簡報中的 material measurement、stackup selection、SI testing 與 sampling / process monitoring；本來源把部分 R&S solution 對應到特定市場分類，例如 [[R&S ZNA]] / [[R&S ZNB]] 的 IL / TDR、[[R&S FSWP]] 的 jitter / phase noise / LDO NSD test、[[MXO]] 的 power rail / motor driver analysis。

R&S CMX500 › 產品定位
依 [[CMX500_specs_en_5216-4127-22_v1100]]，[[R&S CMX500]] 是 universal one-box network emulation and measurement test solution，支援最新 3GPP [[5G NR]] technology，適用於 device testing，涵蓋 [[LTE]]、[[NR FR1]]、[[NR FR2]]，並支援 non-standalone（NSA）、standalone（SA）、FDD 與 TDD。

依 [[CMX500_Features_CSW9-20-0_en_32]]，[[R&S CMX500]] 也提供：

- [[NR FR1]] / [[NR FR2]] signaling 與 TX measurements。
- [[LTE]] signaling、LTE-DTC / direct-to-cell communication、LTE measurements。
- [[NB-IoT]] / NB-NTN signaling。
- [[WLAN]] signaling 與 WLAN TX measurements，涵蓋 802.11a/b/g/n/ac、802.11ax、802.11be、802.11bn 與 2x2 MIMO。
- [[Fading]]、[[AWGN]]、[[BLER]]、[[CSI report]]、[[Throughput measurement]]、[[PER measurement]]。
- Application test、IP traffic analysis、IMS / audio / [[POLQA]]。
- GUI、graphical scripting、Python-based [[XLAPI]] 與 [[SCPI]] remote control。

R&S CMX500
[[R&S CMX500]] 是 [[Rohde & Schwarz]] 的 Radio Communication Tester；依 [[CMX500_specs_en_5216-4127-22_v1100]] Specifications Version 11.00（August 2025），它是 universal one-box network emulation and measurement test solution，支援 [[LTE]]、[[NR FR1]]、[[NR FR2]]、NSA、SA、FDD、TDD、FR1/FR2 RF parametric testing、fading propagation conditions 與多種 OBT hardware configurations。

R&S CMX500 › mmWave extension 與 remote radio heads
[[CMX500_specs_en_5216-4127-22_v1100]] 指出 3GPP FR2 frequency range 測試可由 [[R&S CMX500]] 搭配 [[R&S CMXHEAD30]]、[[R&S CMXHEAD50]] 或 [[R&S CMXHEAD50-Evo]] 執行。Remote radio head 是獨立 compact unit，在 IF 與 5G NR FR2 frequency ranges 間執行 upconversion / downconversion。CMX500 與 remote radio head 的 split concept 可在 5G NR FR2 frequency range 使用短 RF cable lengths，以最佳化 radiated chamber test environments 的 link budget。

適用 radiated chamber test environments：[[R&S CMQ500]] shielding cube 與 [[R&S ATS800R]] CATR rack based antenna test system。

R&S CMP180 › 產品定位
[[R&S CMP180]] 是 Radio Communication Tester。依 [[CMP180 Features and Functions Version 09]]，文件涵蓋 global options、Bluetooth、CDMA2000、GSM、LP-IoT、LTE、NB-IoT、NR、spectrum analysis、UWB、WCDMA、WLAN、[[R&S VSE]] options 與 ordering information。

依 [[CMP180 Specifications Version 08.00]]，CMP180 支援 simultaneous receiver and transmitter testing，並提供 RF generator/analyzer no. 1 與可選 RF generator/analyzer no. 2 的多埠 RF 測試架構。

R&S CMP180
[[R&S CMP180]] 是 [[Rohde & Schwarz]] 的 **Radio Communication Tester**，用於 production / wireless communication device 測試，依文件可配置多埠 RF generator/analyzer、通訊標準 measurement options、waveform options 與 [[R&S VSE]] 分析能力。

R&S CMP180 › 文件依據與版本
本頁目前依兩份 Productions 來源整理：

- [[CMP180 Features and Functions Version 09]]：文件識別碼 **1179.5118.02**，**Version 09**，對應 software **V11.9 or higher**，版權標示 © 2026；此文件是 test applications overview，並明示量測範圍與 tolerance limits 需參考 specifications document **PD 3609.7348.22**。
- [[CMP180 Specifications Version 08.00]]：文件識別碼 **PD 3609.7348.22**，**Version 08.00**，日期 **March 2026**；此文件提供 specifications、general data、ordering information、warranty 與 service。

R&S CMP200 › 產品定位
依 [[CMP200_specs_en_5216-4391-22_v0800]]，[[R&S CMP200]] 與 [[R&S CMPHEAD30]] / [[R&S CMPHEAD50]] remote radio head（RRH）形成 5G NR FR2（mmWave）nonsignaling one-box test solution，目標應用為：

- R&D 的 RF parametric testing。
- Manufacturing 的 high-volume RF parametric testing。
- Fully assembled smart devices 的 pure radiated mmWave setup。
- 具 IF interface 的 mmWave RF integrated circuits 的 mixed radiated mmWave / conducted IF setup。
- 具 mmWave interface 的 mmWave RF integrated circuits 的 mixed radiated mmWave / conducted mmWave setup。

CMP200 本體提供 IF frequency range 的 vector signal analysis 與 ARB-based generator functionality；[[R&S CMPHEAD30]] / [[R&S CMPHEAD50]] 作為 compact remote radio head，負責 upconversion / downconversion 至 5G NR FR2 frequencies。分離式 one-box tester + RRH 架構可在 mmWave frequency range 使用較短 RF cable lengths，以改善 radiated test environments 的 link budget。

R&S CMP200 › Specifications data sheet
本頁硬體、IF、RRH、UWB head、ordering、mechanical、environmental 與 conformance 相關主張主要來自 [[CMP200_specs_en_5216-4391-22_v0800]]：

- 文件名稱：**CMP200 Radio Communication Tester Specifications Data Sheet**。
- 文件代碼：**PD 5216.4391.22**。
- 文件版本：**Version 08.00**。
- 文件日期：**August 2024**。
- 版權：**© 2019–2024 Rohde & Schwarz**。
- 產品：**Rohde & Schwarz CMP200 Radio Communication Tester**。
- 注意：**Data without tolerance limits is not binding**；**Subject to change**。
- Recommended calibration interval：CMP200 與 RRH 為 **12 months**；[[R&S CM-Z310A]] UWB head 為 **24 months**。

R&S CMP200 › Product data 使用限制
依 [[CMP200_specs_en_5216-4391-22_v0800]]：

- Product data 適用條件為 ambient temperature 儲存 3 小時後 warm-up operation 30 分鐘、符合指定 environmental conditions、遵守 recommended calibration interval，且如適用需完成 all internal automatic adjustments。
- Specifications with limits 代表保證的 product performance，以 `<`、`≤`、`>`、`≥`、`±`、maximum、limit of、minimum 等形式標示。
- Non-traceable specifications with limits（n. trc.）依 limits 測試，但因 measuring equipment 不可追溯至 national metrology standards，Rohde & Schwarz 不保證其 performance。
- Typical data（typ.）、nominal values（nom.）、measured values（meas.）均不由 Rohde & Schwarz 保證。
- Uncertainties 採 coverage factor 2，依 GUM 計算。
- 3GPP 標準中 chip rates 以 Mcps 表示，bit rates / symbol rates 以 Gbps、Mbps、kbps、Msps、ksps 表示，sample rates 以 Msample/s 表示；這些不是 SI units。

CMX500 AI Scripting Assistant
[[CMX500 AI Scripting Assistant]] 是 [[Rohde & Schwarz]] 新聞稿中介紹的 [[R&S CMX500]] 5G one-box signaling tester AI-powered scripting tool，使用 generative AI 與 natural language processing 協助測試工程師生成、擴充與理解 [[XLAPI]] scripts。

CMX500 AI Scripting Assistant › 產品定位
依 [[CMX500 AI Scripting Assistant from Rohde & Schwarz facilitates mobile device testing through AI-driven automation]]，[[CMX500 AI Scripting Assistant]] 是為 [[R&S CMX500]] 開發的 AI-driven scripting support solution。來源將它定位為可 automate test script generation and functional testing 的工具，目標是協助 mobile device manufacturers 的 test engineers：

- streamline workflows；
- reduce the risk of errors；
- speed up time-to-market；
- 以 tailored and efficient approach automating domain-specific applications。

來源中的 domain-specific applications 包含：

- R&D [[5G NR]] protocol testing；
- application testing；
- CMX instrument automation；
- many more（來源未展開）。

CMX500 AI Scripting Assistant › Script generation inputs
來源描述測試工程師手動產生 test scripts 時，常需從多個來源彙整輸入。來源明示的來源類型包括：

- [[3GPP specifications]]；
- [[XLAPI]] scripts；
- [[Python]]；
- [[R&S CMX500]] user manual。

[[CMX500 AI Scripting Assistant]] 被描述為用來緩解這種 multi-source script generation challenge 的新 solution。

CMX500 AI Scripting Assistant from Rohde & Schwarz facilitates mobile device testing through AI-driven automation › 重點摘要
- [[Rohde & Schwarz]] 宣稱已開發 [[CMX500 AI Scripting Assistant]]，用於 automate test script generation and functional testing，對象是 [[R&S CMX500]] 5G one-box signaling tester。
- 工具使用 generative AI 與 natural language processing，目標是 streamlining workflows、reducing the risk of errors，以及 speeding up time-to-market。
- 來源描述的使用者痛點是：mobile device manufacturers 的 test engineers 需在時間壓力下，從多個來源手動彙整測試腳本輸入；來源列出的輸入包括 [[3GPP specifications]]、[[XLAPI]] scripts、[[Python]] 與 [[R&S CMX500]] user manual。
- [[CMX500 AI Scripting Assistant]] 的 domain-specific applications 包含 R&D [[5G NR]] protocol testing、application testing、CMX instrument automation and many more。
- 來源宣稱工具可生成 accurate [[XLAPI]] scripts with significantly less time and effort，也可以 extend existing scripts 並 provide explanations for given scripts，以協助較少經驗的使用者理解 scripts 的 structure and logic。
- 來源宣稱工具具有 exclusive access to proprietary data from [[Rohde & Schwarz]]，並存取 derived from expertise of Rohde & Schwarz 的 specialized resources；來源也說明工具以 relevant data 訓練並自動整合 updates，以維持 current and accurate。
- 來源說 [[CMX500 AI Scripting Assistant]] 可透過 various deployment options 取得，但未列出部署類型、版本、license code、order number 或硬體需求。
- 來源說 MWC 2025 Barcelona 的訪客可在 Rohde & Schwarz booth hall 5, booth 5A80 現場體驗該工具。

2026_02_CMX500_Keysight_Sales_Battle_Card › Keysight 相關
- [[Keysight]] — 本 battle card 的競品公司。
- [[Keysight UXM]] — 來源中的 UXM 5G Wireless Test Platforms 總稱。
- [[Keysight E7515P]] — 來源稱 high-end wideband / 5G platform with Wi-Fi as additional capability；quick table 稱 E7515P up to 15 GHz。
- [[Keysight E7515W]] — 來源稱 Wi-Fi 7 / connectivity platform。
- [[Keysight E7515B]] — 來源稱 standard / mid-tier 5G UXM。
- [[Keysight E7515E]] — 來源稱 value / mid-tier 5G UXM。
- [[Keysight E7515R]] — 來源稱 RedCap / IoT-only SKU。

2026_02_CMX500_Keysight_Sales_Battle_Card › 重點摘要
- 來源將 [[Keysight]] 描述為大型美國 test & measurement vendor，總部在 Santa Rosa, California, USA，員工數約 **16,800+**，在 semiconductor、aerospace / defense、cloud 與 wireless testing 具有強市場存在。
- 來源主張 [[Keysight]] mobile communications strategy 越來越 software-led 與 AI-driven，但 [[Keysight UXM]] portfolio 分散於多個 hardware SKUs：[[Keysight E7515P]]、[[Keysight E7515W]]、[[Keysight E7515B]]、[[Keysight E7515E]]、[[Keysight E7515R]]。
- 來源列出 [[Keysight]] portfolio 包含 UXM 5G Wireless Test Platforms、[[ProbSim]] channel emulators、[[Nemo]] field test tools、[[RaySim]] digital twin engine、[[Atlas]] AI-powered device test、C-V2X 與 cybersecurity tools。
- 來源把 R&S positioning 表述為：[[R&S CMX500]] 在 one instrument 中整合 [[NR FR1]]、[[NR FR2]]、[[Wi-Fi]]、[[Fading]]、IP throughput、RF analysis、[[NTN]]、[[RedCap]] 與 end-to-end signaling；而 Keysight 需分散於多個 UXM models、add-on software 與 external tools。
- 來源主張 [[R&S CMX500]] 的差異化包含 one-platform architecture、integrated fading + IP + application testing、unified software ecosystem（[[CMsquares]]、[[R&S CMsequencer]]、AI Script Assistant）、measurement leadership、FR3 / 6G path、cellular + Wi-Fi in one platform，以及 NTN / RedCap / operator certification leadership。
- 來源對 [[Keysight]] 的弱點敘述包含 hardware fragmentation、multi-tool workflow、advanced testing external dependencies、limited legacy、Wi-Fi only on selected models、FR3 / 6G roadmap relies on add-ons。
- 來源的 quick comparison table 將 R&S / CMX500 描述為 one platform：FR1 + FR2 + FR3 + WLAN + fading + IP + NTN + LTE + RedCap；將 Keysight 描述為 multiple UXM SKUs + external tools。

2026_02_CMX500_Amarisoft_Sales_Battle_Card › 實體

- [[amarisoft]] — 競品；來源稱其為 small French private company，提供 software-based 4G/5G network stacks and test systems。
- [[AMARI Callbox Series]] — [[amarisoft]] product line，包含 Mini、Classic、Advanced、Ultimate、Extreme。
- [[UE Simbox Series]] — [[amarisoft]] product line。
- [[R&S CMW500]] — 來源稱其提供 2G/3G legacy continuity，並屬於 R&S full test lifecycle 中的 legacy platform。
- [[R&S CMP180]]、[[R&S CMP200]]、[[R&S CMW100 K06]] — 來源稱其構成 R&S production / ATE scaling path。
- [[Samsung]] — 來源稱 R&S validated NR-NTN RF / RRM / protocol testcases “w/ Samsung”；未提供專案、文件或測試案例編號。
- [[VIAVI]] — 來源稱 R&S + VIAVI 可提供 O-RAN upgrade path，對比 [[amarisoft]] functional DU/RU testing；未提供產品、文件或合作細節。

2026_02_CMX500_Amarisoft_Sales_Battle_Card › 概念
- [[Sales Battle Card]] — 本來源的文件類型；用於競品比較與銷售定位，不是正式 specifications。
- [[Validated Testing]] — 來源用來區分 R&S validated / PTCRB-GCF aligned test cases 與 [[amarisoft]] functional simulation。
- [[Conformance Testing]]、[[Operator Acceptance]]、[[PTCRB]]、[[GCF]] — 來源稱 R&S 支援 aligned RF、RRM、protocol、IMS、VoNR、throughput、CA、mobility tests，而 [[amarisoft]] 不被接受作 operator certification。
- [[NR-NTN]]、[[NTN]]、[[RedCap]] — 來源將其列為 R&S offensive play 與 [[amarisoft]] functional testing 能力對比項目。
- [[Wi-Fi signaling]] — 來源稱 [[R&S CMX500]] 整合 Wi-Fi signaling，含 Wi-Fi 6/6E/7；並稱 [[amarisoft]] 需 external AP/N3IWF 或無 Wi-Fi signaling。
- [[FR2]]、[[mmWave]]、[[Calibrated RF]] — 來源稱 R&S 提供 calibrated FR2 / mmWave，而 [[amarisoft]] 使用 external RRH 且 calibration 以問號標示。
- [[ATE production scalability]]、[[Non-signaling test]] — 來源稱 R&S 可由 CMX validation scale 到 CMP180 / CMP200 / CMW100 production lines。
- [[O-RAN]]、[[ORU conformance]]、[[NES]] — 來源提出 R&S + VIAVI upgrade path，但未展開文件依據。

2026_02_CMX500_Amarisoft_Sales_Battle_Card › 與既有知識的關係
- 既有 [[R&S CMX500]] 頁已依 [[CMX500_specs_en_5216-4127-22_v1100]] 與 [[CMX500_Features_CSW9-20-0_en_32]] 整理正式規格與 Features and Functions。本來源不是 specifications；它補充的是 sales positioning 與競品比較語境。

### Short answer
To compare our Signaling / Non-signaling Tester solution with a competitor for AI without unsupported claims, we need formal R&S product/specification evidence, formal competitor evidence, and AI-specific evidence such as product version, deployment boundary, supported releases, validation method, benchmarks, and security/data-governance details; current passages show that several available sources are sales positioning or press-release claims, not enough for binding technical comparison.[62][66][94]
### Evidence required
| Area | Required evidence before making a comparison | Why it is required |
|---|---|---|
| R&S Signaling Tester facts | Use formal CMX500 specifications and Features/Functions evidence for CMX500 signaling, application, WLAN, fading, automation interfaces, options, order numbers, release/version, and limits.[13][78][79][80] | CMX500 battle-card pages cannot replace CMX500 formal specifications or features documents.[62] |
| R&S Non-signaling Tester facts | Use formal CMP180 and CMP200 specifications/features evidence for non-signaling / production / FR2 mmWave roles, options, ordering data, calibration conditions, and tolerance limits.[16][18][19][20][21] | CMP200 product data distinguishes guaranteed specifications from typical/nominal/measured data, and data without tolerance limits is not binding.[20][21] |
| AI capability facts | Use formal AI product documentation that states product name, version, order/license code, supported CMX software release, XLAPI/Python/package scope, deployment type, validation workflow, error handling, security, data residency, IP handling, and update governance.[26][94][96] | The CMX500 AI Scripting Assistant source is a press-release-style source and does not provide formal product model, version, license code, order number, supported releases, validation method, security/data-residency/IP-handling details, or concrete deployment types.[26][94][96] |
| AI performance claims | Provide benchmark data, correctness metrics, coverage matrix, supported script package list, and validation conditions before claiming better accuracy, less effort, or faster workflow.[92][94] | The current AI Scripting Assistant page records claims such as generating accurate XLAPI scripts with less time and effort, but it explicitly says no benchmark, correctness metric, coverage matrix, package list, or verification conditions are provided.[92] |
| Competitor facts | Use competitor official documents and preferably third-party evidence for competitor product capabilities, AI tools, toolchain, options, versions, SKUs, deployment, and limitations.[62][66] | Current Keysight and amarisoft competitor claims are based on R&S internal battle cards, and the passages say customer-facing documents should additionally use competitor official data and third-party evidence.[62][66] |
| Claims such as “only,” “first,” “leadership,” “lower TCO,” or “fewer boxes” | Provide formal evidence such as validation reports, test case lists, PTCRB/GCF references, TCO model, configuration bill of materials, integration workflow, or other verifiable documentation before using those claims.[28][62] | The passages explicitly classify “only platform,” “first validated,” “leadership,” “lower TCO,” and “fewer boxes” as sales language rather than verifiable technical specifications.[62] |
| Direct AI comparison | Provide a source that directly compares the R&S AI solution and the competitor AI solution on the same workflow, scope, versions, metrics, and constraints.[3][61][62] | The available Keysight comparison positions R&S unified automation against Keysight tools, but the same page says AI Script Assistant, CONTEST, and Keysight RaySim / Atlas / Channel Studio formal boundaries and versions still need sources.[3][61][62] |
| Governance and customer deployment fit | Provide evidence for data residency, air-gapped support, cloud/LLM approval, allowed models, data handling, and “no code leaves the lab” requirements.[53] | The AI-assisted workflow passages say these governance constraints affect adoption, while the CMX500 AI Scripting Assistant PR does not provide data residency, customer IP handling, deployment boundary, model governance, or security controls.[53] |
### What cannot be claimed yet
A binding technical comparison that R&S is better than a competitor for AI is not supported by the cited passages because the competitor claims are internal battle-card positioning and the AI Scripting Assistant sources lack formal version, deployment, validation, security, and benchmark details.[62][66][94]
A claim that the CMX500 AI Scripting Assistant is commercially available in a specific deployment model such as cloud, on-prem, hybrid, or air-gapped is not supported because the source only says “various deployment options” and does not define them.[96]
A claim that R&S has lower TCO, fewer boxes, or AI leadership versus a competitor should not be made from the current evidence because those terms are identified as sales language requiring formal evidence.[28][62]
